This directory holds the exported viewer UI, which is embedded into the binary
by internal/ui (go:embed).

It is build output and is not tracked: run scripts/build-app.sh to populate it
from ./app via `expo export --platform web`. This file exists so that go:embed
always has something to embed, keeping `go build ./...` working without Node —
in that state internal/ui.Available() reports false and the windowed app exits
with an explanatory message.
